geometry: Preserve the exact square canvas, flat-top hex footprint, camera, scale, deep tapered island, centered recessed front stairs, and transparent padding.
Keep one small circular standing patch in the lower third, horizontally centered immediately above the front stairs.
The standing patch is only large enough for Tasklet and remains at the same anchor in every stage.
Let the workshop fill the rear and sides while keeping only the small standing patch clear.
style: Premium cozy stylized 3D toy diorama matching the approved Tasklet runtime tile.
Chunky rounded clay-like forms, broad soft bevels, matte simplified materials, low-frequency surfaces, warm diffuse light, and clean silhouettes.
Use Tasklet's deep teal, navy blue, honey timber, warm sandstone, gold, and amber palette.
Every important feature must remain readable at 256 pixels.
persistentLandmarks: The small rear-center work shelter develops into the signature Grand Focus Atelier without changing its anchor.
The upper-left toolbox and planning point remains upper-left.
The upper-right storage and task-board point remains upper-right.
The small lower-center character standing patch remains open at every stage.
exclude: standing patch in the vertical center

stages.name: Unsorted Corner
stages.narrative: Tasklet has a place to begin, but there is no clear work surface and the few supplies are still unsorted.
stages.floor: Mostly bare muted honey floor with four or five oversized worn plank masses and ample unfinished space.
stages.landmark: One low plain rear-center timber bench beneath a tiny navy awning frame.
props: one empty broad storage crate at upper-right
stages.lighting: Soft neutral daylight with no active workshop glow.
stages.density: Very sparse, tentative, and visibly incomplete.

stages.name: First Workbench
stages.narrative: A clear surface and one focus light make the next useful step easier to see.
stages.floor: Broad honey-timber floor remains dominant with only six large smooth plank divisions.
stages.landmark: The rear-center bench gains a curved navy canopy, one blank plan sheet, and one warm window.
props: one toolbox and two broad rolled plans at upper-left
two stacked storage crates at upper-right
stages.lighting: Clear daylight with one restrained warm window and lantern pool.
stages.density: A modest first focus station with large organized shapes.

stages.name: Focus Workshop
stages.narrative: Tasklet establishes a dependable workshop where plans, tools, and fair stopping points all have a place.
stages.floor: Six to eight oversized smooth honey planks establish the workshop while the lower standing patch remains open.
stages.landmark: The rear-center bench becomes a compact open-front timber workshop with broad curved navy roof and two amber windows.
props: one broad planning bench with a single blank sheet
one large blank task board and tool cabinet
the upper-left toolbox and rolled plans
the upper-right storage crates and pencil-cup shape
stages.lighting: Soft clear daylight with warm workshop windows and two broad amber pools.
stages.density: Clearly established, capable, and organized without tool clutter.

stages.name: Makers Hall
stages.narrative: The workshop grows into a confident hall for planning, making progress, and putting work down again.
stages.floor: Rich broad timber and slate floor masses frame the small lower standing patch without a central platform.
stages.landmark: The same workshop grows into a rounded two-wing makers hall with taller navy roof, broad gold doorway, and three amber windows.
props: the upper-right task board and storage point
one central broad assembly table behind the standing patch
stages.lighting: Golden workshop daylight with restrained doorway, window, and lantern glow.
stages.density: Rich and productive through bold architecture and orderly large forms.

stages.name: Grand Focus Atelier
stages.narrative: Tasklet's home becomes the Haven's definitive landmark for purposeful work, clear plans, and satisfying completion.
stages.floor: Polished low-detail honey-timber decking surrounds the small lower standing patch in broad readable masses.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center hall culminates in a signature grand teal-and-navy atelier with layered curved roof, luminous arched entrance, and one oversized gold leaf-focus emblem without writing.
props: a resolved upper-left planning and toolbox bay
a resolved upper-right task board and storage bay
two oversized neatly stacked supply cabinets
stages.lighting: Clear accomplished golden-hour light with a strong but soft atelier glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature workshop with an unmistakable skyline and no micro-detail.
